Subject: Approval requested: six-week invoice-handling pilot

Hi Morgan,

I propose a six-week pilot to assess invoice handling for a fixed fee of $30,000. This focused engagement would provide a bounded way to evaluate the opportunity before considering any broader commitment; production rollout is excluded.

The pilot would assess invoice handling against your aspiration for 20% shorter handling time. That figure is a target, not a promised outcome: no baseline or measured savings currently exists.

Security approval is required before we can access client data, and no start date has been approved.

Would you approve the six-week pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance? Your approval would move the proposal forward while keeping data access conditional on security approval and production rollout outside this engagement.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
